ablation: plain current low short-horizon residual-volatility rank with the same positive residual-trend gate
allocation: Monday fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash; strict ineligibility exits persist until next scheduled rebalance
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: A-L development evidence and the Ebenezar profile campaign are already observed. Frontier-M is repeated development research, not a fresh holdout. 2023-2024 is spent.
cost_hypothesis: weekly fixed-slot portfolios should keep turnover bounded; exact ATR-linked ladder is frozen at 0/4/8/12%
failure_mode: long-vs-short volatility-rank relief is only a dressed-up low-volatility sort or the opposite rank mismatch performs as well
falsifier: invert the short-vs-long volatility-rank mismatch while preserving the same trend gate and allocation
nearest_incumbent: persistent_low_vol / slow defensive factor balance; distinct transform is within-date mismatch between long-horizon and short-horizon residual-volatility ranks
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive long-minus-short volatility percentile-rank relief with positive 21-day residual trend; top-K deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: New Frontier-M hypothesis registered after L and the completed Ebenezar translation; no Frontier-M return observed before preregistration.
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed 1.0 robust-development floor; do not grid-rescue after failure
thesis: Assets that remain historically volatile on the long horizon but have become unusually calm on the short horizon may offer a transition state not captured by static low-volatility ranking.
timing: completed daily bars only; toolbox owns execution lag; all rolling state is causal and <=365 days
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded from Frontier-M selection; 2025+ and live never drive mutation
